propositions: transition_close.py exceeds 800-LOC hard cap (currently 803 LOC), causing CI Module-size gate to fail and blocking all Gerrit changes from reaching Verified +1

The completion-precheck cluster (_completion_precheck, _has_live_replacement_link, _is_live_ticket, _referencing_commit_exists, _NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES) forms a closed call-graph seam that can be extracted to a new sibling module without logic changes
The split must preserve monkeypatch interception behavior by importing _completion_precheck at module top so close_ticket's dynamic name lookup continues to resolve through the binding

Post-split target sizes are transition_close.py ~480 LOC and new transition_close_precheck.py ~340 LOC, both within policy bands (200-500 and 100-800 respectively) with no file under 100 or over 800 LOC
